description: Stationnement aménagé pour les personnes à mobilité réduite is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agglomération de Chalons en Champagne. Geolocation of parking facilities adapted to people with reduced mobility (PMR) on the city of Châlons-en-Champagne. Coverage: Agglomération de Chalons en Champagne. The portal shows the English title as "Parking for people with reduced mobility" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agglomération de Chalons en Champagne. Its keywords include pmr, solidarite-et-sante, geospatial, personnes-a-mobilite-reduite, chalons-en-champagne, stationnement. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WEB PAGE, KML, CSV, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
